title: Concept: Internal host and port in a response
description: An internal hostname with its service port in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The pair is an address an attacker can try directly once any foothold exists, and the port narrows the service to a known product.
applicability: Deployments that render an internal hostname with its service port into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The pair is an address an attacker can try directly once any foothold exists, and the port narrows the service to a known product.
